description.zh: 经典数字华容道滑块拼图。点击与空格相邻的方块（或用方向键）滑动，把数字 1 到 N²-1 按顺序排好、右下角留空即可过关。提供 3×3、4×4、5×5 三档阶数，自动记录每档的最佳步数与最佳用时，计步计时挑战自我。
description.en: Classic sliding number puzzle. Tap a tile next to the blank (or use the arrow keys) to slide it, and arrange 1 through N²-1 in order with the blank at the bottom right to win. Play 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5 boards with move counting, a timer, and separate best-move / best-time records for each size.

controls.zh: 点击与空格相邻的方块滑动，方向键也可移动，Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Tap a tile next to the blank to slide it, arrow keys also work, Esc / P to pause
